You rate BUYER POWER (Porter's Five Forces) for the analysed company, using ONLY the research and our data below.

Rate each driver by how much it INCREASES the power of buyers:
- alternatives: many alternatives = high
- switching_cost: LOW switching cost = high buyer power
- price_sensitivity: buyers push on price = high
- in_house_option: buyers can easily do it themselves = high
- buyer_concentration: few large customers with negotiating power = high

Rules:
- rating is "high", "medium", "low" or "unknown".
- Use "unknown" when the research has no fact for the driver. Never guess.
- source is the citation number (e.g. "[3]") or "our data". Nothing else.
- For alternatives, use the counts in OUR DATA first.
- reason: max 25 words, state the fact.

Return ONLY this JSON:
{"drivers":[{"driver":"alternatives","rating":"","reason":"","source":""},{"driver":"switching_cost","rating":"","reason":"","source":""},{"driver":"price_sensitivity","rating":"","reason":"","source":""},{"driver":"in_house_option","rating":"","reason":"","source":""},{"driver":"buyer_concentration","rating":"","reason":"","source":""}],"summary":"max 40 words"}

You rate SUPPLIER POWER (Porter's Five Forces) at MARKET level for companies like the analysed company, using ONLY the research and our data below.

Rate each driver by how much it INCREASES the power of suppliers:
- data_access: core data (carrier invoices, rates, shipment data) is controlled, formatted or charged for by a few parties = high
- integration_gatekeepers: TMS/ERP/visibility platforms control access to the data or bundle their own audit/spend module = high
- supplier_concentration: few providers of key inputs = high
- forward_integration: suppliers (carriers, TMS/ERP vendors, data platforms) launch the same product themselves = high

Rules:
- rating is "high", "medium", "low" or "unknown".
- Use "unknown" when the research has no fact for the driver. Never guess.
- source is the citation number (e.g. "[3]") or "our data". Nothing else.
- You may use "our data" (platform owners among competitors) for integration_gatekeepers and forward_integration.
- reason: max 25 words, state the fact.
- Do not claim that any specific company is a supplier of the analysed company.

Return ONLY this JSON:
{"drivers":[{"driver":"data_access","rating":"","reason":"","source":""},{"driver":"integration_gatekeepers","rating":"","reason":"","source":""},{"driver":"supplier_concentration","rating":"","reason":"","source":""},{"driver":"forward_integration","rating":"","reason":"","source":""}],"summary":"max 40 words"}

## Website check (market presence)
Only for competitors with HQ outside the focus market. Loads each homepage and looks for hreflang, /de/ pages, a de. subdomain or a brand.de domain. No AI. Unreachable sites keep the old rule.

## Forces: research once per run
If Force Assessments already has buyer + supplier power for this run_id, they are reused (same run = same scores). To research again, delete the 2 rows of this run in Force Assessments.
